{{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This is a list of '''[[List of alternately colored Pokémon|alternately colored Pokémon]] in various [[Pokémon animation|Pokémon animated media]]'''. This page also includes [[Shiny Pokémon]] as well as other Pokémon with unique appearances and features. =={{aniseries|PTS}}== Pokémon with a different color scheme have appeared in the {{pkmn|animated series}} even before the {{pkmn|games}}, with a [[pink Butterfree]] being one of the first to appear in ''[[EP021|Bye Bye Butterfree]]''. Many alternately colored Pokémon appear in the [[Orange Islands]] saga due to the setting's tropical climate. Many of these Pokémon have different color palettes than the palette for [[Shiny Pokémon]] of that species that were introduced in {{2v2|Gold|Silver}}.
